name: IcuData

source.verification: Release asset of unicode-org/icu release-79.1: its SHA-256 matches the GitHub release asset digest and its SHA-512 matches the release SHASUM512.txt. LICENSE and the README are byte copies from the archive. icudt79l.dat is a subset generated from the archive's icudt79l.dat (SHA-256 208a8392975e81a351fd9e3759f7a2c7a5659c97ef258c7a7435e2d9c31a61ce, 4321 items) with the official icupkg.exe of icu4c-79.1-Win64-MSVC2026.zip (release asset, SHA-256 c4ae1cbadb4187007f76f8b1bcf3a10deb699395ab3c74df01362bfdfa0f1ac2 matching the release digest): 'icupkg -tl -r remove.txt icudt79l.dat <dir>/icudt79l.dat', where remove.txt lists every item of 'icupkg -l' except the kept items in the notes. The output file name must stay icudt79l.dat because icupkg prefixes the item names with the package name; with that name two runs produce the same bytes.

licenses.upstreamExpression: LICENSE from the data archive (UNICODE LICENSE V3 and the third-party data licenses)

notes: ICU data subset for text boundaries (Docs/Design/Font/08-ThirdParty.ko.md section 8.3): the font backend registers it with udata_setCommonData. Kept items (39): brkitr/burmesedict.dict, brkitr/char.brk, brkitr/cjdict.dict, brkitr/de.res, brkitr/el.res, brkitr/en.res, brkitr/en_US.res, brkitr/en_US_POSIX.res, brkitr/es.res, brkitr/fr.res, brkitr/it.res, brkitr/ja.res, brkitr/khmerdict.dict, brkitr/ko.res, brkitr/laodict.dict, brkitr/line.brk, brkitr/line_cj.brk, brkitr/line_loose.brk, brkitr/line_loose_cj.brk, brkitr/line_loose_phrase_cj.brk, brkitr/line_normal.brk, brkitr/line_normal_cj.brk, brkitr/line_normal_phrase_cj.brk, brkitr/line_phrase_cj.brk, brkitr/pt.res, brkitr/res_index.res, brkitr/root.res, brkitr/ru.res, brkitr/sent.brk, brkitr/sent_el.brk, brkitr/thaidict.dict, brkitr/title.brk, brkitr/word.brk, brkitr/word_POSIX.brk, brkitr/zh.res, brkitr/zh_Hant.res, nfkc.nrm, ulayout.icu, uemoji.icu.

brkitr holds the boundary rules, the locale break resources and the dictionaries (Thai, Lao, Khmer, Burmese, CJK); nfkc.nrm is used by the CJK dictionary engine; ulayout.icu and uemoji.icu are the layout and emoji properties ICU loads from data.
Staging next to the executables (Engine/Content/Internationalization) comes with the font backend (FT2); tests read the file from this folder.
